title: Applications for speedrun SR008 are now open
gist: a16z opened applications (Oct 12 - Nov 1, 2026) for its speedrun SR008 accelerator, now an in-person San Francisco residency running Feb 1 - Apr 18, 2027. The deal is up to $1M ($500K for 10% via SAFE plus up to $500K in the next round within 18 months), $10M+ in partner credits, no board seats, and a two-week target close.

insights.claim: a16z speedrun SR008 invests up to $1M per startup: $500K upfront for 10% via a SAFE, plus up to an additional $500K into the company's next round within 18 months.
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: The $500K-for-10% upfront implies a ~$5M post-money valuation benchmark for a16z's pre-seed accelerator entry.
insights.quote: We invest up to $1M: $500K for 10% upfront via a SAFE, plus up to an additional $500K into your next round within 18 months.

insights.claim: a16z speedrun aims to close its investments in two weeks and provides $10M+ in cloud, AI, and software credits from 200+ partners.
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: Fast closes and large compute/AI credit bundles are being used as competitive weapons for winning early-stage AI founders.
insights.quote: We aim to close in two weeks, so you can get back to building.

insights.claim: a16z speedrun does not take board seats, arguing that at the earliest stage founders should control their own boards.
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: Founder-friendly governance is positioned as a differentiator in the crowded accelerator market.
insights.quote: And we don’t take board seats. At this stage, we think founders should be the ones in control of their boards.
insights.locator: And we don’t take board seats

insights.claim: a16z opened its own San Francisco office this year, which is a big part of why the speedrun program has become an in-person, twelve-week residency.
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: Signals a16z doubling down on San Francisco density as the hub for early-stage company formation.
insights.quote: This year we opened our own office in San Francisco, and it’s a big part of why speedrun is now a residency.
insights.locator: This year we opened our own

insights.claim: The SR008 residency runs February 1 to April 18, 2027 in San Francisco, with a founder retreat February 2-4 and Demo Day on April 13; applications are open October 12 to November 1, 2026 (11:59 PM PT).
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: Sets the timeline for when the SR008 cohort will hit the fundraising market (mid-April 2027).
insights.quote: The SR008 residency runs February 1 – April 18, 2027, kicking off with our founder retreat February 2–4, and Demo Day is April 13.

insights.claim: a16z speedrun argues that who founders build next to matters, placing a hand-picked cohort in its office alongside the team with talks from Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Fei-Fei Li, and Sam Altman.
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: Access to marquee AI figures is part of the pitch to attract top AI founders.
insights.quote: Who you build next to matters. For twelve weeks, you’ll work in person out of our office, alongside the speedrun team and a hand-picked group of founders at your stage.
insights.locator: Who you build next to matters

insights.claim: a16z speedrun offers Demo Day access to thousands of investors, go-to-market programs (Brand Lab, Launch Lab, AI Faire, Tech Week), and a talent network of 171K+ engineers, designers, and product people that has produced 250+ hires.
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: Accelerators increasingly compete on distribution and hiring infrastructure, not just capital.
insights.quote: Hiring? Our talent network has 171K+ engineers, designers, and product people, and 250+ hires.

insights.claim: a16z cites FLORA, Runware, k-ID, and Sekai as examples of founders for whom speedrun acted as a first believer.
insights.speaker: Samira Behrouzan, Joshua Lu, Rose Johnson
insights.so_what: These named alumni are the program's showcase portfolio companies to track.
insights.quote: We want to be your first believers, just like we were for the founders behind FLORA, Runware, k-ID, and Sekai.
insights.locator: This year we opened our own
